question: What are the top 5 items with the highest year-over-year growth percentage in total sales revenue for the year 2023?
sql:
SELECT 
  item_number,
  item_description,
  ROUND(revenue_2022, 2) as revenue_2022,
  ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) as revenue_2023,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(revenue_2023 - revenue_2022, revenue_2022) * 100, 2) as yoy_growth_pct
FROM (
  SELECT 
    item_number,
    item_description,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2022 THEN sale_dollars ELSE 0 END) as revenue_2022,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2023 THEN sale_dollars ELSE 0 END) as revenue_2023
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) IN (2022, 2023)
  GROUP BY item_number, item_description
)
WHERE revenue_2022 > 0 AND revenue_2023 > 0
ORDER BY yoy_growth_pct DESC
LIMIT 5
